# Sismos de Diseño

```{r}
#| include: true
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "report.R"))
Standard.target <- c("GISTM", "CDA", "ANCOLD")
```

## Respuesta de sitio {#sec-site-response}

{{< include /_chapters/site.model.es.md >}}

{{< include /_chapters/site.uncertainty.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/PGA.ES.qmd",
    stem = "site-pga",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "PGA de sitio"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/PGA.TR.ES.qmd",
    stem = "site-pga-tr",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "PGA de sitio por período de retorno y condición"
  )
}
rm(i)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
```

```{r}
  NOTE <- .deckNote("sha", "Evaluación de Amenaza Sísmica", "Los espectros por condición de sitio y los factores de amplificación se desarrollan en el anexo %s.")
  if (nzchar(NOTE)) cat("\n\n", NOTE, "\n\n", sep = "")
  rm(NOTE)
}
```

## Criterios de diseño sísmico para taludes {#sec-criteria}

{{< include /_chapters/deq.criteria.es.md >}}

{{< include /_chapters/deq.kmax.es.md >}}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SiteTable))) {
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.operation.ES.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-table",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(ID.target = ID.gmdp),
    root = root,
    context = "tabla de criterios operacionales de relaves"
  )
  .knitReportBlock(
    path = "/_tbl/DEQ.PGA.ES.qmd",
    stem = "criteria-obe-pga",
    sites = SiteTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(
      ID.target = ID.gmdp,
      Standard.target = "GISTM",
      Stage.target = "Operation"
    ),
    root = root,
    context = "tabla GISTM de PGA de diseño por condición de sitio"
  )
}
rm(i)
```
